description: Head-movement mini-game GA03: slow side-tilt hold exercise. Voice-guided, segmented motion only — tilt ear toward shoulder, hold 5 seconds, return to center, alternating left and right, 3 left + 3 right = 6 reps. A one-prompt start calibration (tilt left once) learns which roll sign means left. Temple tap starts and replays; no camera, no mic/ASR.
name: ear-tilt
